ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 25% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric patch on the distal left lobe; scattered, small, roughly circular white spots (mottling) distributed across the right lobe; dark pigmentation dominant in the central and proximal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-depth variations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels across the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular points visible primarily on the inner-half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of organic protrusions and parasitic colonization (barnacles) visible on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: White-water spray and foam occlude the leading edge and central lower portion of the fluke structure.
